description: Validate a PDF against PDF/UA-1 with veraPDF and list every failed rule (rule id, description, number of failed checks, link to a plain-language explanation). The automatic fix is then run on the file and validated again, so the result also says which failures the fix removes and whether the file then passes — measured on this file, not estimated. Give either 'url' (a public http(s) address of the PDF, max 10 MB) or 'pdf_base64'. The file is not stored and the fixed file is not returned here.

language.description: Document language the fix sets when the PDF declares none (BCP 47, e.g. en-US, de-DE, fr-FR). Default en-US.

pdf_base64.description: The PDF file encoded as base64, if it is not online (max 10 MB decoded).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the PDF (max 10 MB).

name: check_pdf_accessibility
title: Check a PDF for PDF/UA accessibility
